source: No existing termbase entry. 'Kulturerbe-' is reserved for 'heritage' in the termbase (Kulturerbe-Dorf/-Moschee/-Souks); 'inn' is deliberately distinct from 'Hotel' in the source (ix.kind.heritage-inn vs ix.kind.hotel). Genus verified: Duden, https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Gasthaus - headword 'Gast.haus, das' (WebFetch, 2026-09-19).

No existing termbase entry; BRIEF.md directs deriving it by the same pattern as the confirmed twins 'Qaisariyah Souq -> der Qaisariyah-Souk' and 'Al-Hamidiyah Souq -> der Al-Hamidiyah-Souk'. Genus verified against three published repository occurrences of the compound head 'Souk': src/content/attractions/qaisariyah.md:15 ('Der Qaisariyah-Souk gehoert ...'), hamidiyah-souq.md:15 ('Der Al-Hamidiyah-Souk ist ...'), craftsmen-souq.md:14 ('liegt der Handwerker-Souk').

No existing termbase entry (BRIEF.md: no German form yet). Literal generic meaning per gloss_regel: 'weaving' = the hung textile object => Gewebe (Duden, saechlich), hyphenated with the untranslated craft name 'Sadu'. Genus verified: Duden, https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Gewebe - headword 'Ge.we.be, das' (WebFetch, 2026-09-19). Bracket-gloss '(Webstoff)' at first mention follows the published in-repo pattern (craftsmen-souq.md:14 'Tanur (Lehmofen)'; khalifa-museum.md:14 et al. 'Madschlis (Empfangsraum)'), applied once in koot.body only, not in the short koot.alt per the brief.
